layout.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-8 space-y-6 md:space-y-8
layout.card: bg-[#121212] border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-sm
layout.card_dense: bg-[#121212] border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm

portfolio_value_card.classes: col-span-1 md:col-span-12 lg:col-span-4 bg-gradient-to-br from-teal-900/50 to-slate-900 border border-teal-500/20 rounded-2xl p-6 relative overflow-hidden
portfolio_value_card.description: Large display of portfolio value (e.g., ₹76.5L). Use a subtle grain or noise overlay if possible. The gradient must be dark-theme compatible.

risk_alert_banner.classes: flex items-start gap-3 p-4 rounded-lg bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 text-red-500 mb-6
risk_alert_banner.description: Top level alert. Icon on left, title and description on right. 'Your portfolio needs attention'.

risk_cards_grid.description: Small cards showing specific risks: AMC Dominance, Large Cap Overweight, Asset Class Balance. Each card has a red icon, title, and a small badge or stat.

performance_chart_card.classes: col-span-1 md:col-span-12 lg:col-span-8 bg-[#121212] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-6
performance_chart_card.description: Contains Recharts AreaChart. X-axis: months. Y-axis: hidden or minimal. Two areas: Portfolio (Teal) and Benchmark Nifty 500 (Gray). Needs a top-right time toggle (1M/3M/6M/1Y/3Y/5Y).

tabs.classes: w-full bg-[#1A1A1A] p-1 rounded-lg border border-white/5
tabs.description: Use Shadcn Tabs. Triggers should be data-[state=active]:bg-[#27272A] data-[state=active]:text-white.

fund_list_item.classes: flex items-center justify-between py-4 border-b border-white/5 last:border-0
fund_list_item.description: Left: AMC Avatar (use Fallback text like 'HD', 'SB' with bg-slate-800) + Fund Name + Category badge. Right: 3Y Return % (green text) + Category Rank (e.g., 39/40).

progress_bar.description: Used in MF Concentration tab. Show the % text above it.

horizontal_stacked_bar.classes: flex w-full h-4 rounded-full overflow-hidden mb-6
horizontal_stacked_bar.description: A single bar with multiple colored segments representing AMC allocation (e.g., 50% red, 24% blue, etc). Use inline styles for width %.

animations.hover_card: transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-white/10 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-black/50

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building the 'Insights' or 'Portfolio Analysis' page for a dark-theme fintech app.
MUST use 'lucide-react' for all icons (AlertTriangle, TrendingUp, TrendingDown, Info, ShieldAlert, CheckCircle).
MUST use 'recharts' for the Performance Trend chart. Use AreaChart with gradients (`<defs><linearGradient>`).
MUST use Shadcn components: Card, Tabs, Progress, Badge, Avatar.
For the AMC Concentration stacked bar, manually create a flex container with colored divs for the percentages.
Implement the layout as a Dashboard pattern: Sidebar on left (optional or just a top nav), main content area with max-w-7xl.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements like Tabs, Toggles, and Alert Banners.
Ensure the Portfolio Value card has the specific Teal gradient 'bg-gradient-to-br from-teal-900/40 to-slate-900'.
Do not use generic placeholder images. Use Avatar with initials for AMC logos (e.g., 'HD' for HDFC, 'SB' for SBI).
